entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. To ensure quality service, this call may be recorded. For returns or product support, press 1. For all other inquiries, press 2.
Thank you for calling VeloFit Support, my name is David. How can I help you today?
My VeloBand is broken. I need to start a return.
I can certainly help with that. To pull up your order, could I get your full name and email address?
Jane Doe. J-Doe at email dot com. Just tell me if I can return it.

Okay, I have your account pulled up now, Ms. Doe. I see your recent order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker. I'm sorry to hear it's not working. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
It's defective. The pulse tracking is not working at all, and it won't sync my workouts. The thing is useless.
I understand your frustration. A device that won't sync is definitely a problem. Let me just quickly check the return eligibility for this item. One moment, please.
Okay, thanks for your patience. I see here that the item was delivered 22 days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day window for a full refund.

Absolutely. Since the item is defective, there will be no charge for the return shipping. I'm generating a prepaid return label and I'll email it to you right now. As soon as we receive the broken unit, we'll process a full refund.

And Ms. Doe, I see that you're a VIP member with us. For the trouble you've had with this device, I'd like to add a credit to your account for complimentary expedited shipping on your next VeloFit order.
That's fine. As long as the email is on its way.
I've just sent it. It should be in your inbox now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
